title: FBI-UAP-D022, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-6, Western United States Event, 2026

pages.description: A dark, dimly lit view from the back seat of a car at night, looking forward through the windshield. On the left, a person wearing glasses sits in the driver's seat with one hand on the steering wheel, seen in profile from behind. On the right, a second person with long hair sits in the front passenger seat, seen from behind. Between and above them a rearview mirror is visible mounted near the top of the windshield. Through the windshield a straight road with dashed centerline markings extends into the distance toward a dark hill or ridge under a faint dusk or night sky. A bright, blurred round glow (a light source or bright spot) appears in the upper-center area above the road. Headlamps illuminate the pavement ahead. The seats and car interior are silhouetted in warm, low light.

observations.claim: Two people are seated in the front of a vehicle, viewed from behind
The driver on the left wears glasses
A hand rests on the steering wheel
A rearview mirror is visible near the top of the windshield
A road with a dashed centerline is visible through the windshield
A bright blurred round light appears in the upper-center of the scene
The scene is set at night or dusk with low ambient lighting
A dark hill or ridge is visible on the horizon ahead
